summary: Steel Aermotor tower on Zimmerman Hill, Elk County PA, once a U.S. Forest Service lookout; removed, with its location still evident on FR228.

facts.status_note: Register says removed; a trail listing says it was removed in the 1990s

access.note: Reached by FR228 in the Allegheny National Forest; the trail listing shows a Permanently Closed label, so check the road before driving in

visit.trail_note: Graded dirt and gravel road; the trail listing says the tower location is still evident

events.note: A 1940 map of the Hallton area labels a Zimmerman Hill Fire Tower

evidence.quote: This steel Aermotor tower belonged to the U.S. Forest Service and has been removed.

corrections.why: Mapcarta places the tower in Millstone Township, Elk County, at the same coordinates as the brief. The register page read did not name a county. Medium confidence; editor should check the county against the register before changing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Mapcarta places the tower in Millstone Township; the 1940 Pastmaps page title says Warsaw Township for Hallton. Not resolved; the story gives only the county.

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing or fire record found in two searches. The register gives the material and owner only. Trail listing (onX) gives the 1990s removal and location evident, but also shows a Permanently Closed label without explanation. The 1940 map label is the only pre-removal evidence; whether it is the same structure as the register site is not stated by any source. Brief county Forest conflicts with Mapcarta's Elk County; see corrections.
